highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.4 expands supported platforms and fixes graphics view reliability across desktop and mobile.
highlights_body: The release adds Linux Bionic and GTK4 support while improving Android, tvOS, Tizen, and Windows deployment.

breaking.title: Blazor imports no longer inherit ComponentBase
breaking.body: The generated Blazor _Imports type no longer implements the component interfaces. Do not derive application components or behavior from that generated import type.

bullets.lead: Linux, GTK4, Tizen, and .NET Framework support expanded
bullets.detail: Adds Linux Bionic assets and Gtk4 views, expands Tizen native architectures, and adds net48 validation support.
Separates device and simulator native targets so tvOS applications receive the appropriate framework assets.
Fixes Android MAUI tab-switch rendering and a Cairo assertion crash in GTK4 drawing areas.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic, net48, and compatibility support

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: This preview introduced servicing reliability and native dependency updates later rolled into 3.119.4.
preview_summaries.v3.119.4-preview.1.1: Preview 1 expanded platform support and fixed graphics view behavior across Android, GTK4, and tvOS.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates HarfBuzz platform packaging alongside the expanded Linux, Tizen, tvOS, and .NET support.
